cards.name: Pick the Brain
cards.oracleText:
Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it and exile that card.
Delirium — If there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, search that player's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as the exiled card, exile those cards, then that player shuffles.

cards.name: Pick Your Poison
cards.oracleText:
Choose one —
• Each opponent sacrifices an artifact of their choice.
• Each opponent sacrifices an enchantment of their choice.
• Each opponent sacrifices a creature with flying of their choice.

cards.name: Picklock Prankster // Free the Fae
cards.oracleText:
Flying, vigilance
Mill four cards. Then put an instant, sorcery, or Faerie card from among the milled cards into your hand.

cards.name: Pick-a-Beeble
cards.oracleText:
Visit — Roll a six-sided die. Put a number of luck counters on Pick-a-Beeble equal to the result and create a Treasure token. Then if there are six or more luck counters on Pick-a-Beeble, claim the prize!
Prize — Create two Treasure tokens, then sacrifice Pick-a-Beeble and open an Attraction.
